primary_metric.name: pooled VALIDATION average precision (AP)
primary_metric.definition: concat over 23 VALIDATION videos: y_t = (target_t >= 0.5) on loss_mask universe; p_t = model probability; AP via aic_video_highlight.ftnet.evaluation.average_precision (step-wise, tie-safe)
primary_metric.checkpoint_policy: min VALIDATION masked soft BCE (frame-level, identical to B0-v2); tie -> earliest epoch

seeds.staging_rule: Screening (3 seeds) results are labelled SCREENING and are never formal conclusions. Promotion decisions use the pre-frozen gates below. B0 and A1 are pre-registered for all 8 seeds unconditionally (B0 = reproduction baseline; A1 = single primary arm of Probe A; neither is a result-dependent selection).

b0_architecture.forward: [visual_projected(96) | zero(96) | zero(32)] -> fusion(224->128) -> 5-block dilated TCN -> Y head
b0_architecture.identity: bitwise-identical to the AutoDL B0-v2 forward (semantic slots are literal zeros)

a1_architecture.forward: identical module structure; every block is frame-independent (receptive field = 1 timestep); no TCN/GRU/attention/cross-timestep pooling exists
a1_architecture.invariance_evidence: changing one timestep's input changes only that timestep's output (verified numerically in tests/test_ftnet_bottleneck_probes.py)

c_architecture.forward: [T, D] -> Linear(D->96)+LayerNorm(96)+GELU -> Linear(96->128)+GELU -> same 5-block dilated TCN (k=5, dilations 1..16, dropout 0.1) -> Y head
c_architecture.note: structurally mirrors B0's visual pathway (256->96->128 via the 224-wide fusion with dead slots); the only change is the input representation and its first projection

model_contract.frozen_modules: no Q head; no new losses beyond prereg; no semantic inputs; no native inputs

training_contract.loss_b0_a1_c: masked_binary_cross_entropy (soft_vote target, frame-level) - unchanged from B0-v2
training_contract.deterministic: torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True, warn_only=True); cudnn deterministic; fixed seeds
training_contract.checkpoint: best = min VALIDATION masked soft BCE (tie earliest); last.pt always saved; canonical resume supported
training_contract.train_only_normalization: visual256 unchanged from v2; C1/C2 caches store TRAIN-only per-dim standardized features (stats frozen in cache manifests)
training_contract.uniformity: all arms share optimizer/scheduler/epoch budget/batch/checkpoint policy/evaluator; only the preregistered variable differs

probe_a_temporal.primary: paired delta AP(A1 - A0) over 8 seeds

disposition_rules_8_seed.MODERATE: mean dAP <= -0.005 AND A0 wins >= 5/8 (and not STRONG)

probe_b_supervision.audit_required_before_mil: audit_annotation_granularity.py must verify (a) exact clip -> sampled-frame mapping, (b) >50% of supervised frames are covered by >=2 overlapping windows (broadcast/aggregation evidence), (c) target recomputation matches the frozen adapter, (d) zero failures; otherwise MIL is NOT RUN (STOP condition)
probe_b_supervision.bag_definition: one MTurk annotation unit (mturk_label.json window) = one bag; members = sampled frames with source_frame_id in [start_frame, end_frame) AND loss_mask=1; bag target = vote / 5.0; bags with zero members are excluded (no fabricated supervision)
probe_b_supervision.isolation: aggregation only within one bag; never across video/candidate/split
probe_b_supervision.loss: equal-weight mean over bags of BCE(clamp(agg, 1e-6, 1-1e-6), bag_target); no frame-level broadcast loss inside MIL arms
probe_b_supervision.eval: same frame-level p_t output and same VALIDATION AP evaluator
probe_b_supervision.promotion_gate_3seed: best MIL arm by 3-seed mean AP; promote at most 1 if mean dAP vs local B0(3seed) > +0.005 AND wins >= 2/3 AND per-video AP mean >= B0 - 0.005 AND no NaN/Inf/anomaly

formal_gate_8seed.POSITIVE: mean dAP >= +0.005 AND wins >= 5/8 AND per-video AP >= B0 - 0.005 AND no anomalies
formal_gate_8seed.INCONCLUSIVE: 0 < mean dAP < +0.005, or not promoted (screening only), or anomalies
